verdict.rationale: Yapily's Data API documents a get-accounts endpoint that 'Returns all accounts and balances for the end user associated with the presented consent token' (yapily-docs-27), and account/balance data access is repeatedly described as core functionality (yapily-docs-2, yapily-docs-15, yapily-docs-34). However, no evidence explicitly frames this as a real-time pre-payment NSF/risk check workflow, nor documents latency guarantees, freshness of balance data, or an explicit pattern linking balance-check to payment initiation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying the balance endpoint to pre-payment NSF/risk-check use cases, guidance on real-time freshness/staleness of returned balances, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this workflow.
